body:
> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Rewrite of the existing post https://pipelinersusa.com/14-warning-signs-your-sewer-pipes-may-be-leaking/ (post 13736, Gutenberg). Versions: `14-warning-signs-sewer-line-leak-REWRITE-2026-10-08.md` (the rewrite) and `guardian-fixes-2026-10-09\3-14-warning-signs-DRAFT.md` (the Oct 9 guardian audit: PASS, no copy changes, only an optional OTTO BlogPosting schema fix: headline to match the H1, real dateModified, author Jake Shaker as a Person).

# Key facts
- **Status:** LIVE 2026-10-08 (Kim: "go live, author Jake Shaker"); indexing requested the same day. Slug must not change.
- **Focus keyword:** sewer line leak (170/mo, KD 20, from the keyword pool), the same focus aligned on Sep 23, so title and H1 stayed. Secondary: leaking sewer pipe (260, KD 13).
- **Why rewritten:** four of the 14 signs (water bill, meter, pressure, tap water color) describe a water supply leak, not a sewer leak; the closing section claimed 24/7 crews and excavation.
- Ad check: no paid impressions Sep 7 to Oct 6.
- Backups: `fix-backups\2026-10-08_14signs-rewrite\`.
